Ingénieur en aéronautique, Jim se consacre depuis des années à un projet secret et hors normes : construire sa propre fusée et accomplir le premier vol spatial habité en amateur. Mais pour réaliser son rêve, il va devoir apprendre à le partager…

An aeronautical engineer, Jim, has always dreamed of becoming an astronaut but failed at the European Space Agency recruitment competition. Unable to give up, he has been devoting himself for years to a secret and unusual project: building its own rocket and accomplish the first manned space flight as an amateur.
